t_advice_summary_textbox.text: There are two groups of gnomes, one with earthy/natural colours and one with brighter colours. The numbers seems to rise within each group but sometimes changes to the other group. There are multipliers (x1 or x5) shown before the gnomes are shown. The advice recommends trying a colour change on a x1 multiplier so as not to lose too many mushrooms.

vb_textbox.text: There seems to be two groups of gnome colours, one more typically found in nature (green, brown, orange, yellow) while the other is less often found (pink, purple, red and blue). Some of the colours are brighter than others. The number of mushrooms found by a gnome seems to vary from 0 to 9, and can be multipled by 1 or 5. The multiplier is shown before choosing the gnome. It seems like each group has a run of higher numbers of mushrooms being found; during a run it makes sense to pick the same "group" for all the x5 multipliers. If there is a x1 multiplier the other group could be chosen to check if they have higher numbers of mushrooms.The hat heights can be different on different gnomes but I'm not sure if that makes a difference to the number of mushrooms picked or not.
